explanation: His seven voyages reached the coast of East Africa. One brought a giraffe back to the Ming court, where some hailed it as a qilin, a creature of good omen.

claims.text: Zheng He led Ming treasure fleets across the Indian Ocean between 1405 and 1433.
Zhang Qian, Xuanzang and Faxian lived centuries earlier and led no treasure fleets.
Zheng He made seven voyages, which reached the coast of East Africa.
A giraffe brought to the Ming court by Zheng He's fleet was hailed as a qilin, an auspicious creature.
